findings.title: The required-check enforcement surface is outside the code-owner boundary
findings.claim: Of the 37 tracked files that produce or implement the checks the live ruleset requires, 0 are matched by an owner-carrying .github/CODEOWNERS pattern, so require_code_owner_review cannot demand the repository owner for a change to the checks themselves, and 9 of the 14 merges whose diff touched that surface in the window were approved by the hpo-approver App alone.
findings.mechanism: main-protect-checks (23698884) arms require_code_owner_review; .github/CODEOWNERS decides which paths that bites on. Its owner patterns cover the 39 capped policy files and nothing that executes inside the required-check jobs. The enforcement surface is derived: 6 .github/workflows/*.yml + 26 scripts their non-comment lines execute + 4 wired hooks + .claude/settings.json.

evidence.unit: files matched by an owner-carrying CODEOWNERS pattern / enforcement-surface files
evidence.machine: 8-core Apple M1, 8 GB, shared audit box

findings.title: A required check is executed from the change it is checking
findings.claim: A one-line change to .claude/workflows/policy_lint.mjs (process.exit(errors > 0 || rc ? 1 : 0) -> process.exit(0)) makes the policy-docs required-check command exit 0 on a corpus the same run reports as red, with stdout byte-identical, and the lane built to catch a gutted check does not notice.
findings.mechanism: governance.yml's policy-docs runs actions/checkout with no ref:, so corpus and checker both come from the PR's tree; the job conclusion is the script's exit status. policy_lint_mutants.mjs exercises assertAcceptance, which returns before the mutated exit line.

evidence.unit: exit status of the required-check command on a red corpus, before -> after the one-line change
evidence.machine: 8-core Apple M1, 8 GB, shared audit box
evidence.contention_note: exit statuses + ERROR-line counts in a scratch clone, not contention-sensitive; load1 14.4

perturbation.change: replace process.exit(errors > 0 || rc ? 1 : 0) with process.exit(0) in a scratch clone, corpus made red by renaming one citation target

findings.proposed_fix_scope: re-execute the checker from a trusted ref (git show origin/main:.claude/workflows/policy_lint.mjs against the diff's corpus), or take D11-01's fix. ~15 lines of workflow.
